blurb: `docs/` holds {files} short encyclopedia articles (the opening paragraph of each), one Markdown file per article; the file name is the article title. Most of them have nothing to do with any of the {n} questions below. Every question needs two articles: either one article leads to the entity the second one describes, or the question compares two entities.
header:
# hq1 — two-hop QA over a shared corpus with distractors (HotpotQA distractor, hard)

Family `qa-multihop`, split `dev`. Workspace = `fixtures/` (`docs/*.md`, {files} article files, {mb} MB).
{n} HotpotQA dev-distractor questions (level `hard`; 8 bridge, 2 comparison; yes/no answers excluded)
share one corpus: each question's 10 paragraphs (2 gold, 8 distractors) plus the 10 paragraphs of 110
other dev questions, merged by title. Stresses: wide search, lookalike distractor articles, carrying a
bridge entity between reads. Checker: normalized exact match or token F1 >= 0.8; score = correct / {n}.
Knobs: `hidden/build.json`.
